thread:
Chris: hi team — i'm a new hire (start date 2024-07-15) and want to add my spouse + toddler to benefits effective my start date. i'm transitioning from a contractor role and my spouse's employer plan ends 7/14. i missed the contractor -> full-time enrollment window because the portal didn't show FT options. is this a QLE? what docs do you need?

Nora: welcome, @Chris! yes, loss of other coverage (spouse's plan ending 7/14) counts as a QLE. we'll need proof of the termination date (COBRA/termination letter or employer coverage end notice) showing 7/14, plus marriage cert and child's birth cert. Please upload to the secure portal.

Chris: thanks. i have an email from spouse's HR confirming end date and a screenshot of benefits termination. will that work? also curious about FSA — can i enroll in health FSA and dependent care now or is that only at open enroll?

Jamal: the HR email + screenshot should be fine as provisional proof; benefits will request final carrier verification. For FSAs: if you have a QLE, you can typically enroll mid-year for health FSA but dependent care rules vary by plan. We'll confirm plan-specific rules and deadline.

Chris: ok uploading now. also, payroll — will premiums be prorated for July since start is mid-month? i don't want a big catch-up on first paycheck.

payroll-bot: Automated: Premiums for mid-month starts are prorated based on coverage days unless you request a different schedule. If a retro reconciliation is required for prior months, payroll can split across two pay cycles if requested before cutoff. Reply "split-2" here to split.

Chris: uploaded files: dependent_docs/Lopez_spouse_termination_20240710.pdf, dependent_docs/Lopez_marriage_20220701.pdf, dependent_docs/Lopez_child_birth_20210903.pdf.

Nora: got the upload, thanks. we'll submit the QLE and request 2024-07-15 effective date. Benefits will try to set the spouse's coverage to start 2024-07-15 to match your hire. If carrier requires exact 7/01 effective we will note.

Jamal: on the FSA question: your plan allows health FSA enrollment on QLE; dependent care FSA requires a special election only if your spouse's coverage change affects eligibility — we'll confirm. If you'd like to enroll in health FSA now, say so and we'll add the enrollment step.

Chris: please enroll me in health FSA. i want payroll to split any retro premium across two paychecks if needed — replying "split-2". thanks!

benefits-bot: Reminder: Health FSA enrollment noted. Payroll split request recorded as "split-2". Benefits will confirm carrier enrollment and effective dates within 2 business days after verification. If carrier needs additional docs, you'll be pinged here.

Nora: closing the loop: filed QLE for 7/15, health FSA enrolled, payroll split requested. expected follow-up within 48 hours. welcome aboard! :tada:
